verdict.rationale: Lambda documents SSH access to its On-Demand Cloud instances and lets you add your own existing SSH key to a workspace. Root-level control is stated explicitly only for Managed Slurm clusters (sudo or root on all nodes). For single ODC instances it is only implied, through 'a high degree of control over your Python environment' and cloud-init launch configuration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of root/sudo privileges on ODC GPU instances, and independent or hands-on corroboration of root access on instances.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment

citations.quote: You can connect to your On-Demand Cloud (ODC) instances directly through SSH
If you have an existing SSH key, you can add it to a workspace and use it to connect to your instances.
All nodes are directly accessible, and users have system administrator privileges (sudo or root) across the cluster.
